'''The Sy Snootles Show''' was a series of concerts performed by the [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] [[Music/Legends|singer]] [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CW">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref> The concerts consisted of matinee and night shows<ref name="Trivia" /> and took place on [[Friday/Legends|Fridays]] and [[Saturday/Legends|Saturdays]] from 12 to 4.<ref name="CW" /> In addition to Snootles, the shows also featured "the [[Color|blue]] guys", "some red [[Gender|dudes]]" and "purple people".<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/deception-trivia-gallery|text="Deception" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref> A [[The Sy Snootles Show (poster)/Legends|series of posters]], written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], were put up to promote the show. It eventually became so successful that a "sold out" message was added to the the posters.<ref name="CW">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>
